admission_rules: explicit license or documented permission for this research use
authenticity and counterfeit labels established independently of this model and independently of an unverified marketplace badge
no hash or URL overlap with the HypeVault catalog, Phase 35, Phase 36, or Phase 37
the locked final-test images are not opened
authentic_only_policy: Authentic-only images may be described as an acceptance study. They do not support a false-authentic rate or PR-AUC for counterfeit detection.
research_questions: Does the frozen DINOv3 model generalize to a genuinely unseen sixth watch brand from an independent dataset?
Why did the Richard Mille leave-one-brand-out model confidently classify some counterfeit images as authentic?
target_selection_rule: Choose a watch brand outside the excluded lists only if a corpus meets the admission rules. Do not choose from model predictions. If no corpus qualifies, record BLOCKED and do not score.
